_README: Starter micro-action quests. A quest is a small, finishable action tied to a value/pattern. Progress is encouraging, never punishing: no streak-shaming, no guilt copy. 'cadence' is a gentle suggestion, not a rule. Users can also create quests from a flow's closing action. Keep ids stable.

quests.title: Say one honest no
quests.summary: Decline one request this week that you'd normally accept out of guilt.
quests.why: Boundaries are a skill that strengthens with reps. One clean no teaches people (and you) that your limits are real.
quests.checkInPrompt: How did saying no land — for them, and for you?

quests.title: Start badly, on purpose
quests.summary: Do a deliberately rough first version of something you've been perfecting in your head.
quests.why: Perfectionism stalls action. A bad draft is worth more than a perfect intention because you can actually improve it.
quests.checkInPrompt: What happened when you let it be imperfect?

quests.title: Notice one energy leak
quests.summary: For one day, notice a single recurring thing that drains you more than it should.
quests.why: You can't plug a leak you haven't located. Awareness comes before change.
quests.checkInPrompt: What did you notice was quietly costing you energy?

quests.title: Reach toward one person
quests.summary: Send one message to someone you've been meaning to connect with.
quests.why: Real-world connection is the thing this app most wants for you. A single message can reopen a door.
quests.checkInPrompt: How did reaching out feel, honestly?

quests.title: Catch one harsh thought
quests.summary: Notice one moment of harsh self-talk and rewrite it as you'd speak to a friend.
quests.why: You don't have to believe the kinder version yet. Practising it changes the default over time.
quests.checkInPrompt: What was the harsh line, and what did you replace it with?

quests.title: Protect one real break
quests.summary: Defend a 20–30 minute break this week that is only for you.
quests.why: Rest isn't earned by finishing everything — nothing is ever finished. It's how you keep showing up.
quests.checkInPrompt: Did you take it? What got in the way, or what helped?

quests.title: Name one thing you want
quests.summary: Say out loud, or write down, one thing you actually want — without justifying it.
quests.why: People-pleasing buries your own wants under everyone else's. Naming one is how you start to hear yourself again.
quests.checkInPrompt: What did you want, and what was it like to say it plainly?

quests.title: Finish one small thing
quests.summary: Pick one tiny lingering task and complete it today.
quests.why: Momentum is built from finished small things, not planned big ones. Done beats perfect.
quests.checkInPrompt: What did you finish, and how did done feel?
